newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae investors to receive Inparsa shares.
newsitem.headline: Sonae investors to receive Inparsa shares.

text.p: Investors in Portuguese industrial group Sonae Investimentos may receive shares in a separate holding company Inparsa before the expiry of the period when rights can be exercised, a Sonae source said.
"Shareholders in Sonae Investimentos who held the shares when Inparsa was established will have the right to receive shares in Inparsa," the source told Reuters.
"We are expecting that by the beginning of February the rights will be transacted," the source added.
Investors who hold two shares in Sonae Investimentos have the right to receive one share in Inparsa.
Inparsa, established on Tuesday, holds stakes that were previously held by Sonae Investimentos in wood products subsidiary Sonae Industria and services group Pargeste.
